ten: Chap nhan hoa von khi chuoi dai
mo_ta: Khi chuoi co N lenh (Bigmouse: 3), bo TP duong va chi dat SL o hoa von: chuoi thoat o 0 thay vi cho lai.
vet: Chuoi dai dong boi [sl] voi tien thu ~ 0 (am nho = phi), khong phai TP duong.

ap_cheo: Luat 'cat DD': thu bien N nho / lon tren luoi - doi lai het lai cua chuoi dai.
rui_ro: Cat het co hoi cua chinh chuoi nguy hiem nhat.
